from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document extracted with its title and specific legal causes."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The official title or header of the judgment document")
    case_causes: list[str] = Field(description="The specific charges or causes of action identified (e.g., '交通肇事罪', '合同纠纷')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document supporting the extracted case causes")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
